title: Set up a company retirement plan (SIMPLE IRA, SEP-IRA, or 401(k))
summary: You are both employer and employee. Choose a plan structure that fits the business and supports your own retirement goals.
detailsHtml:
The three main plan types

SIMPLE IRA: Easiest to administer. Mandatory employer match (3% match OR 2% non-elective of all wages). For 2026: standard contribution limits $17,000 + $4,000 catch-up at 50+; super catch-up at 60–63 is $5,250. SECURE 2.0 §117 added higher limits ($18,100 + $3,850 catch-up) for SIMPLE plans of employers with 25 or fewer employees, OR employers with 26–100 employees who elect to provide either a 4% non-elective contribution or a 4% (1% increased) match. No Roth option historically, though SECURE 2.0 now permits it if the plan offers it. Best for businesses with 1–25 employees who want minimal complexity.

SEP-IRA: Employer-only contributions, up to 25% of each eligible employee's compensation. Same percentage for everyone (including owner) — so owners with high incomes effectively must contribute proportionally for employees, which gets expensive.

401(k) with Safe Harbor provisions: Higher limits ($24,500 employee + employer match/profit sharing up to $72,000 total). Roth option available. Safe Harbor provisions exempt the plan from ADP testing under several formulas: (a) basic match: 100% on first 3% + 50% on next 2% (effective 4% for a 5%-deferring employee); (b) enhanced match: 100% on first 4% or higher; (c) non-elective: 3% of compensation to all eligible regardless of deferral; (d) QACA: 100% on first 1% + 50% on next 5% with 2-year vesting and auto-enrollment. More expensive to administer ($1,500–$5,000/year) but vastly more flexible and higher-limit. The right choice once business profit and owner-employee retirement goals warrant.

Contribution comparison, owner takes $200K salary, business has 5 employees averaging $60K: SIMPLE IRA (3% match): Owner contribution: $17,000 + 3% = $23,000 Employer match for employees: ~$9,000 Total cost: $32,000 SEP-IRA at 15% of all compensation: Owner: 15% × $200K = $30,000 Employees: 15% × $300K = $45,000 Total cost: $75,000 (but $30K for owner) Safe Harbor 401(k) (4% match): Owner: $24,500 employee + match + profit share potentially up to $46,000+ Employees: 4% match = $12,000 Plan admin: ~$3,000 Total cost: ~$60,000 (~$46K for owner)
